summary: Excess rent already paid for {apartment} becomes a credit on the next bill.
realLife: New York City's 2023 apartment order directed that sums charged and paid above its permitted increase be credited in full against the following month's rent.
gates: The case record identifies the applicable order, permissible charge and payment ledger.
inGame: needs: applicable order, permissible charge and payment ledger.

turns.what: The next rent bill shows the credit.
The bill can be corrected without recording a refund of money never collected.
turns.pulledBy: The incorrect charge was never paid
